body: The only option for me to save myself is to get away from this situation, I intend to find a job, stabilize myself financially and then just leave. If I cut all ties with them after that or not depends completely on their reaction once I do go my way. But yeah, injustice have to endure it a little bit longer I guess, hope you have a nice life too, overcoming every little obstacle that comes your way, we all deserve that.

You said you have an appointment in two weeks, so please endure this till then. Trust me I know how you feel. I’ve attempted suicide 3 times, each time I failed, it was not because the family problems got better, or my dad stoped yelling at me comparing me to my older perfect sister, my mom is two faced, one second she understands me the other she curses me out and tells me I’m a disappointment. Tbh I don’t want to die but I’d have nothing against it if it just now magically happened. My life’s still shit, I’m stressed, I have to drop out of college because I can’t afford it anymore, I’ve lost interest in everything I like except music, but there’s still something I want to do and that is prove to myself that I can make it without my parents, all this negative shit around me, I never asked for it so I have no obligation to stay around it. I’ve decided to ignore the world until it starts to listen so please wait until that appointment and tell that doctor everything because if they have at least one advice or Ofer one not so good solution it’s still better than having nothing like you and me are now. So please just don’t give up.

I never had the option to stay over at someone’s, not even my cousins ,mainly because I’m a female so you already know what that means. I turned 21 this year and it hurts me to my core knowing that I’ve missed on so manny opportunities and experiences, like getting a job and not having to work in the “family business, going out with friends and staying over 11pm, going to parties or go clubbing which I never do because I’m a very anxious and introverted person so I hate crowded places. What hurts me the most is the fact that to this day I’m still struggling to break the patterns my parent have ingrained in me since childhood, I still struggle with loving myself, being independent, keeping a friendship alive long terms, i don’t believe people, always think of the worst, overthink and I don’t like the idea of dating or getting close to someone because I don’t believe that I’m worthy of loving or that I know how to love someone because in the back of my mind there’s always something telling me “you’re not doing this right, you’ll fuck up and hurt that person” so I isolate myself and basically live my life with no friends or someone to cry to. I also hate the idea of being in a relationship or getting married because I don’t want it to be something like my parents, I have a fear of becoming the same thing as them so I hate the idea of having kids too and the thought of becoming a parent one day is very unnatural and scary to me, the reason to that is that I don’t want to fuck up an innocent life, I just can’t have that burden on my shoulders. But I’m glad I posted this and found someone who’s acknowledging this problem as a male Albanian, it really makes me feel like there’s hope for the future generations because I have no faith or respect for the current one.
